HOW GRANDISON CAN HELP

From a repair to a new room.

Plan a bathroom that works day to day

For bathroom installation in Dunfermline, explain who uses the room and what needs to change: a shower instead of a bath, more storage or different fitting positions. If it is your only bathroom, raise that early so the programme and temporary disruption can be discussed.

  • Bathroom renovation options →
  • Bathroom planning guide →

Include the smaller plumbing jobs

A renovation is a useful time to mention a troublesome tap, a replacement toilet or pipework that needs moving. Plumbing repairs can also be a separate enquiry. Photographs of the fitting and its connections help distinguish a straightforward replacement from a wider alteration.

  • Plumbing repairs & installations →
  • Shower rooms →

Coordinate heating with the room layout

Tell Connor about radiators or heated towel rails before walls and floors are finished. For boiler installation, explain your current system and hot-water needs; for boiler servicing or boiler repairs, give the appliance details and any symptoms when booking.

BEFORE YOU ENQUIRE

A useful bathroom brief

Before choosing a suite, note the room dimensions, door swing and the positions of the current bath, basin and toilet. Keeping a layout and changing it can involve very different amounts of pipework. Explain whether this is your only bathroom so access and the programme can be discussed.

  • Photograph the room from more than one angle.
  • Separate essential changes from finishing preferences.
  • Mention fittings you have already bought.

Include your postcode and preferred timing. Confirm the agreed work, who supplies the fittings and any preparation or finishing tasks before booking.

GOOD TO KNOW

Your questions,
answered.

Can you discuss work in Rosyth or Dalgety Bay as well?

Yes. South and west Fife enquiries are welcome. Send the property postcode and job details so Connor can confirm availability for that location.

Should I buy the bathroom suite before enquiring?

Have the dimensions, connections and proposed layout checked first. If you have already chosen products, share links and delivery dates so their suitability can be discussed.

Can I enquire about a small plumbing repair in Dunfermline?

Yes. Say which tap, toilet, sink or pipe is affected, when the issue happens and whether any replacement parts have already been bought.
